notes: «حدثنا أبي» is a bare relation (rule 7). «أن محمد بن جعفر، حدثه» names him as the source the previous link had (rule 5).
«تابعه ابن وهب عن عمرو» is a mutabaʿa: a variant group, never a second route (rule 4).
«ورواه يحيى بن أيوب عن ابن أبي جعفر» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a second variant group.
